svg.title: QuickDraw converter: illustrated feature guide
svg.desc: Thirteen numbered examples rendered by quickdraw-cli. Core, portable and printer profiles are labeled. Labels are added separately; these are not classic-Mac reference outputs.
svg.text: Actual PICT conversions. Explicit portable profiles. No classic-fidelity claim.
CORE = strict sample | PORTABLE = approximate policy | PRINTER = separate opt-in
A region hole clips every later drawing
Same rectangle, changed origin; old ink stays
XOR overlaps; drawing twice restores ink
Indexed palette and packed RGB placement
Exact NFNT strike, scaled with extra spacing
Supplied TrueType and CFF1 geometric glyphs
Decoded PNG with alpha and affine placement
Rotated text and fractional line widths
PNG pixels / SVG and PDF paths or full raster
Images: original synthetic PICTs rendered by this CLI. Captions/layout added separately.
Known unsupported drawing fails; a successful conversion still carries diagnostics.
Read docs/features.md for every supported family, exact boundaries and reproducible examples.
